name: wacc_from_target_debt_to_equity_ratio
question_template: A company finances itself at a target market-value debt-to-equity ratio D/E of {DE} (market value of interest-bearing debt divided by market value of common equity; no other capital sources). Its annual nominal cost of equity ke is {KE} percent, its annual nominal pretax cost of debt kd is {KD} percent, and its corporate tax rate T is {T} percent. The cost of equity exceeds the pretax cost of debt. Derive the capital weights from the ratio alone: wD=(D/E)/(1+D/E) and wE=1-wD. The annual interest tax shield on the debt cost is kd*T/100 percentage points, and WACC=wE*ke+wD*(kd-kd*T/100). Apply the tax shield only to debt. Use exact arithmetic and do not round any intermediate value.

slots.description: Exact debt capital weight wD=(D/E)/(1+D/E) implied by the target debt-to-equity ratio, as a plain ratio between 0 and 1.
Exact annual reduction in the debt cost from the interest tax shield, kd*T/100, in percentage points (positive number).

program:
def solve():
    de = P["DE"]
    ke = P["KE"]
    kd = P["KD"]
    t = P["T"]
    if ke <= kd:
        raise ValueError("cost of equity must exceed pretax cost of debt")
    wd = de / (1 + de)
    we = 1 - wd
    shield = kd * t / 100
    wacc = we * ke + wd * (kd - shield)
    return {
        "final": wacc,
        "debt_weight_from_target_ratio": wd,
        "debt_cost_tax_shield_percent": shield,
    }
